Dataset: FAOSTAT crops and livestock products: coffee, green (production, area harvested, yield)
Access_Method: Bulk download (publisher zip, ~34 MB) filtered to the three countries by scripts/ingest/ds01_faostat_yields.py; the query API now requires an authorization header
License_Or_Terms: FAO open data licence - attribution required
Notes: National, not district. Processed file data/processed/ds-01-coffee-national-yields.csv with dictionary. Validated 2026-10-08: units converted once (kg/ha to t/ha), production/area reproduces the published yield within 2 percent in every row. Ethiopia 2023-2024 carry E and I flags (estimated, imputed). Calibrates yield_vol and base_yield_t_ha (data/rt7-calibration.csv).

Source_Organization: Climate Hazards Center, UC Santa Barbara
Used_By: RT-7: climate factor for yield_vol; EXP-10 index design
Notes: Needs a documented district polygon (boundaries) before extraction.

Dataset: NASA POWER daily meteorology and solar
Regions: Colombia-Huila; Colombia-Cauca; Ethiopia-Jimma; Ethiopia-Sidama; Vietnam-Dak Lak; Vietnam-Lam Dong
Used_By: RT-7: heat-stress overlay on yield; CapEx solar asset cash flows
Notes: Point requests at district centroids chosen by judgement (coordinates in the query log and the dictionary); 0.5 x 0.625 degree grid, so a regional signal, not a plot. Processed file data/processed/ds-03-district-climate-monthly.csv. Validated 2026-10-08: every point returns every month, mm/day converted to monthly mm by calendar length, no fill values. Used so far only for the observation-only rows in data/rt7-calibration.csv (annual rainfall CV, yield-rain correlation); the climate factor in RT-7 is still a latent draw.

Dataset: World Bank Commodity Price Data (the Pink Sheet): Coffee, Arabica and Coffee, Robusta
Regions: Global (Arabica for Colombia and Ethiopia; Robusta for Vietnam)
Access_Method: XLSX download; the file's doc id changes each release and is read off the landing page (current id in scripts/ingest/ds04_pink_sheet.py)
Variables: monthly nominal USD/kg, Arabica (ICO indicator) and Robusta (ICO indicator)
Notes: Converted USD/kg to USD/t (x1000). World reference prices, not farm-gate; the gap is basis_local, unmeasured. Processed file data/processed/ds-04-coffee-prices-monthly.csv. Validated 2026-10-08: unit read from the header row before conversion, continuous monthly, Arabica above Robusta except three months in 1979. Calibrates price_vol and price_base_usd_per_t; fwd_price_usd_per_t is derived from the base with an assumed discount.

Dataset: ICO coffee indicator prices and Coffee Development Report statistics
Variables: composite and group indicator prices, US cents/lb
Used_By: RT-7: cross-check on DS-04; LIT-035 is the reference read
Notes: LIT-035 documents the 2019/20 range and variability flags.

Dataset: Our World in Data: coffee bean production (derived from FAOSTAT)
Notes: Derived; cite DS-01 as the source of record. Available as a grapher CSV (coffee-yields) and usable as a cross-check on DS-01 when the FAOSTAT bulk file is unreachable.

Dataset: Partner cooperative loan book and repayment history
Source_Organization: Partner (to be identified via the business-research market map)
Variables: loan-level origination and repayment records per RT-1
License_Or_Terms: Confidential - member-level data never enters the repo
Used_By: RT-7: base_pd_*, lgd_*, pd_anchor_dscr, pd_dscr_sensitivity, residual_correlation (via EXP-25)
Notes: Row-level data lives in the Vault. Only aggregates come back. LIT-031 warns cooperative records are often informal.

Dataset: Partner cooperative member register and delivery records
Variables: members, farm area, deliveries by season, share of crop delivered
Used_By: RT-7: n_members, avg_area_ha, area_sd, hedge_ratio_*, member_yield_*, side_sell_*
Notes: LIT-033 shows registers are obtainable through unions and the Cooperatives Agency in Sidama.
